newsitem.title: USA: Fed consolidates some U.S. banking data.
newsitem.headline: Fed consolidates some U.S. banking data.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Friday it was dropping one weekly report on banking statistics and folding it into another existing report in the interests of greater efficiency.

The Fed discontinued its H.4.2 weekly balance sheet release for large domestic banks. Starting on Oct 11, the data will now appear in the Fed's H.8 release titled "Assets and Liabilities of Commercial Banks in the United States."
The H.8 release contains weekly and monthly balance sheet data for all U.S. commercial banks, breaking the data down into large and small banks and foreign-related banks.
